summary: Devon Energy completed its acquisition of Coterra Energy on May 7, 2026, via merger of a wholly-owned subsidiary. The deal was previously announced on February 1, 2026. This 8-K files pro forma financials reflecting the merger. Coterra survived as a direct wholly-owned subsidiary. No price, premium, or advisor details are in this filing. The pro forma balance sheet and income statements are presented for illustrative purposes. Watch for integration updates and potential synergies in future quarters; risk-arb focused on regulatory clearance and closing mechanics, now resolved.
